scope.claim: Offline source crosswalk and owned residuals for two accepted preserved-before captures; no newly observed method joins or query reduction.
scope.sourceOverlayBoundary: Pinned source references describe product mechanisms; diagnostic overlays and their binary identities remain pinned in the capture packets.
scope.closure: Root dispositions preserve unresolved attribution. T02 review/merge, downstream acceptance and full program completion are separate gates.

diagnostics.mechanism: EfOpenTelemetryStore durable ingestion/commit and retention paths; separate query APIs also exist (CommitCapturesDurablyAsync, ApplyPendingRetentionAsync).
diagnostics.uncertainty: No batch ID joins a command to a runtime event, exact store method, or retention/query operation.
diagnostics.relevance: Separate diagnostic-store cost; no disable-telemetry or runtime-provider reduction claim is supported.

placement.mechanism: EfExecutionPlacementStore.TryClaimAsync reads a lease and may insert; FindAsync is another reader. Actor-provider and placement-pump callers are source candidates.
placement.uncertainty: No exact actor-provider/pump path, lease owner/result, or row identity is joined.
placement.relevance: Separate placement-store cost; no reduction is selected from the read/insert pair.

iam.mechanism: EfUserStore.FindAsync and FindByEmailAsync both read identity_users; principal-factory and sign-in service paths are distinct candidates.
iam.uncertainty: No exact user-ID/email lookup or authentication caller/result is joined.
iam.relevance: Separate REST admission/authentication cost; do not attribute it to workflow runtime store.

activity_state.mechanism: EfActivityExecutionStateStore exposes FindAsync, CountAsync, ListPageAsync, ListByParentPageAsync; SaveAsync reads before upsert.
activity_state.uncertainty: Multiple readers/writers and activities are candidates. No operation/method span, execution/activity identity, or row count is joined.
activity_state.relevance: Runtime PostgreSQL cost; reduction relevance requires exact caller and post-pagination evidence.

inspection.mechanism: EfActivityExecutionInspectionStore.SaveAsync pre-reads; FindAsync and ListSummariesPageAsync are other readers. The accumulator/checkpoint writer path is source-confirmed.
inspection.uncertainty: No join to SaveAsync, FindAsync, checkpoint staging, or a specific checkpoint/row. Do not call this a Studio/API readback or assume it unnecessary.
inspection.relevance: Runtime PostgreSQL cost; checkpoint relation remains unproved per command.

workflow_state.mechanism: EfWorkflowExecutionStateStore exposes FindAsync, ListAsync, QueryPageAsync, QueryHealthPageAsync.
workflow_state.uncertainty: Multiple read shapes; no method ID, execution ID, or returned-row count maps this group to a call.
workflow_state.relevance: Runtime PostgreSQL cost; pair count is not a page or row count.

liveness.mechanism: EfExecutionLivenessStateStore has save/try-save/find/versioned-find and recovery-page paths. Four SELECTs per resumption sweep are source-compatible with ListRecoveryPageAsync but are not joined to it.
liveness.uncertainty: Request-root/drain groups do not identify method/owner. Sweep groups have a boundary but no exact method, returned-row, or target-execution ownership.
liveness.relevance: Request-path liveness is runtime cost; background sweeps stay separate from the primary execution.

dispatch.mechanism: EfWorkflowDispatchStore.FindAsync, ListAsync and QueryAsync read dispatch state. SaveAsync pre-reads and validates a lifecycle transition; admission and completion paths also read dispatch records. No exact SELECT caller is observed.
dispatch.uncertainty: No method span, dispatch/execution identity, retry result, or checkpoint link is joined.
dispatch.relevance: Runtime request-path cost; no access reduction inferred.

hold.mechanism: EfWorkflowHoldStateStore.FindAsync reads a control-plane ID; ListForWorkflowExecutionAsync walks workflow and global rows because embedded holds can target the execution. SaveAsync also loads before upsert.
hold.uncertainty: No read method, execution identity, or returned-row result is joined.

bookmark.mechanism: HttpEndpointMiddleware and StimulusRouter query waiting bookmarks through EfBookmarkStateStore to route/resume eligible executions.
bookmark.uncertainty: No caller or bookmark/execution result joins the request-root pair; source order does not prove a match/resume occurred.
bookmark.relevance: HTTP-specific admission cost; keep separate from REST-start shared computation.

incident.mechanism: EfIncidentStateStore exposes FindAsync, CountAsync, CountHealthAsync, ListAsync and ListBlockingAsync. Incident state is also a supported checkpoint participant; this unmatched SELECT is not joined to a participant operation.
incident.uncertainty: No checkpoint ID, participant operation, method, or row result is joined.
incident.relevance: Potential checkpoint-related runtime cost; no participant row or write is claimed.

source_reference.mechanism: WorkflowStartDispatcher.ResolvePinnedExecutableAsync lists artifact source references to select live provenance. EfWorkflowExecutableSourceReferenceStore has FindAsync and artifact/definition/general page readers. PinnedExecutableRead reads the executable, not its source references.
source_reference.uncertainty: No caller, source-reference identity, or lookup result is joined.
source_reference.relevance: Runtime request admission cost; distinct from activity materialization.

trigger_binding.mechanism: EfWorkflowTriggerBindingStore.QueryPageAsync reads total count and a bounded page. HttpEndpoint/StimulusRouter use bindings for admission; the router reuses a supplied match set. The observed two commands do not establish two redundant binding lookups.
trigger_binding.uncertainty: No claimant/binding method or returned identity is joined; counts do not prove one lookup per trigger.
trigger_binding.relevance: HTTP-specific route admission; not part of REST companion computation.

program_final.status: owned residual; exact method and row ownership unresolved
program_final.decision: Retain this measured family in end-to-end accounting. No access removal is selected from this aggregate. No blanket method-instrumentation extension is required to assess the already delivered paging change or the bounded materialization spike.
program_final.acceptanceTrigger: T18 must disclose the residual with final before/after command groups. Before any selected change touches this store, or any claimed saving relies on this group, resolve the relevant caller/identity boundary. Investigate an unexplained final group delta before attributing it to an optimization.

materialization.accountableOwner: Program lead through T07 strategy spike
materialization.decision: Use post-pagination evidence to distinguish repeated materialization from other activity-state consumers; do not treat every table read as a materializer call.
materialization.acceptanceTrigger: Before T08/#2396 selects a design or #1306 implements it, identify the relevant reader/writer and unchanged-baseline interval, staged visibility, ownership, flush and cold-fallback behavior; otherwise record a reviewed no-change decision.

settlement.accountableOwner: Program lead through T04 post-response attribution
settlement.decision: Retain observed resumption-sweep commands as separately counted background work. Four liveness SELECTs per sweep are source-compatible with recovery scans, not proof of their exact method or exclusive target-execution ownership.
settlement.acceptanceTrigger: T04 must import these exact packets and distinguish request tails, settled target state and independent polling, preserving any missing row/owner join and the unresolved historical 25–695 attribution. No second baseline harness or blanket polling attribution.
